title: Rewrite whatever is reused
statement: Anything reused from another lesson or item, such as a check, step names, narration or a feedback line, must be rewritten for its new place.
example: One narration line that made no sense was the same string in three lessons.
detail: Hand reviews traced defects to pieces carried over from elsewhere: a quick check from a lesson on another skill, which taught the wrong skill; guided practice under another lesson's step names; a narration line that made no sense and was the same string in three lessons; and a feedback line that invented a story detail by copying a sentence from an earlier item.
